name: Cow Squad
overview: COW SQUAD follows the comedic adventures of Daisy, Sarge, and Carrots as they use their wits, courage, and cow-tech gadgets to help anyone who needs a hand…er hoof. Daisy, Sarge, and Carrots are back on the farm, ready to use their wits and cow-tech gadgets to answer Code Moos around the tri-county area. Always eager to lend a helping hoof, these Cows operate out of their high-tech underground headquarters to protect their fellow farm animals from everything from pirate gophers to rock-and-roll goat festivals. Whether they are settling a dispute between ducks and geese, or going undercover as sheepdogs, this unbeatable barnyard unit proves that no problem is too big when you have the right gadgets and the right attitude.
